author: human
request:
Bug report: opening /owners?page=0 — or any page value below 1 — renders the
error page instead of the owner list. Expected behavior: the owner listing
treats any page value below 1 as the first page and responds with the normal
listing (HTTP 200). Find the cause, fix it, and cover the fix with a test.

author: product-requirements-expert
title: Owner list shows the first page when asked for a page below 1
summary: Requesting the owner list with a page value below 1 (e.g. /owners?page=0) currently renders the error page. The owner listing must treat any page value below 1 as the first page and respond with the normal listing.
acceptance_criteria: given /owners?page=0, when the owner list is requested, then the response is HTTP 200 with the normal owner listing, not the error page
given any negative page value (e.g. -1), when the owner list is requested, then the response is HTTP 200 with the normal owner listing
given a page value below 1, when the owner list is requested, then the response is the same as for page 1: the first page's owners are listed and the first page is marked current
given a page value below 1 together with a last-name search, when the search runs, then it behaves as the same search on page 1 (list, single-owner redirect, or not-found as REQ-OWN-002 specifies)
given page values of 1 or above, when the owner list is requested, then paging behaves exactly as before
non_goals: the veterinarian directory's paging: the owner named only the owner listing; recorded as an open question in docs/prd.md
page values beyond the last page
changing the page size or the pagination controls
notes: Grounded in intake-decision line 1 (decisions array empty; the request quote alone sets scope). Root observation relayed by dispatch: the listing computes a zero-based page index as page - 1, which is invalid for page < 1. One behavior, so one data-driven test over page values such as 0, -1, and a large negative value. No Non-Goals row touched; no autofix records to audit. PRD delta: REQ-OWN-005 anchor, narrative sentence, Done-when bullet, and an open question on the veterinarian directory.

author: system-design-expert
architectural_fit: Covered by architecture-principles.md § pattern catalog, Web controller row: normalizing a request parameter to its permitted range is binding, not a business rule, so the clamp belongs in OwnerController and adds no controller-rule deviation. Cause (grep-verified, IDE oracle not connected, weaker basis): OwnerController.findPaginatedForOwnersLastName builds PageRequest.of(page - 1, pageSize), which throws IllegalArgumentException for page < 1 and surfaces as the error page. Fix: normalize page to max(page, 1) once at the processFindForm entry, before both the repository query and addPaginationModel. The same normalized value then drives the zero-based index and the currentPage model attribute (AC3), and every branch runs as for page 1: list, single-owner redirect, not-found (AC4). Page values >= 1 pass through unchanged (AC5). testing-principles.md (web-level placement for controller normalization) puts the test in OwnerControllerTests as a MockMvc test, not an extracted unit test. The only docs/ write is REQ-OWN-005 joining the OwnerController Contracts row.
integration_points: Framework transport: MockMvc drives the real MVC dispatch and binding (the sanctioned transport double per CLAUDE.md Testing Strategy).

Repository boundary (OwnerRepository): reuse the file's existing @MockitoBean seam. OwnerRepository is a Spring Data JPA interface: a hand-written double would implement the whole JpaRepository surface, and a real implementation needs a JPA slice that cannot drive the MVC dispatch. The test asserts the Pageable reaching findByLastNameStartingWith is page index 0 with the unchanged page size (e.g. eq(PageRequest.of(0, 5)) or an argument captor), and asserts model currentPage == 1.
Binding: no new entry point. The existing @RequestParam int page on GET /owners stays a request-scoped scalar; no persisted type is newly bound.

patterns.description: parameter-range normalization is binding and sits in the controller
existing loop-over-inputs MockMvc shape to follow for the data-driven test over 0, -1, and a large negative value

risks.risk: Normalizing only the Pageable index while passing the raw page to addPaginationModel would render currentPage as 0 or negative, breaking AC3.
risks.mitigation: Normalize once at the processFindForm entry and use the normalized value for both the query and the model; assert currentPage == 1 in the test.

risks.risk: Clamping after subtraction, i.e. computing page - 1 before the clamp, overflows for Integer.MIN_VALUE to Integer.MAX_VALUE, which PageRequest accepts: the query then runs with a huge offset instead of failing or listing page 1 (security-principles.md: fail closed on untrusted input).
risks.mitigation: Clamp the 1-based page before any arithmetic; include Integer.MIN_VALUE in the test's input set.

risks.risk: Path scaling: the owner listing is a paged query bounded by the fixed page size; the slice adds no path that scales with data. docs/system-design.md carries no § Scale and Load section, so there is no row to cite.
risks.mitigation: Simplest readable form (a Math.max clamp); no new row is required because the slice adds no scaling path.

notes: No design-doc-autofix records in the log; the audit was skipped. Out of scope per prd-entry non_goals: VetController paging has the same page - 1 computation and fails the same way. It stays out of this slice (recorded as a PRD open question). Also out of scope: non-numeric page values and pages beyond the last. Doc gap for the owner: docs/system-design.md has no § Scale and Load section; a later slice that adds a data-scaling path should seed it.

author: change-grader
summary: clamp owner-list page below 1 to the first page

blast_radius.note: One production method in OwnerController.processFindForm, its controller test, a PRD sentence, bullet and open question, and one Implements-column cell in system-design.md; one module and no sensitive or security-surface paths.

semantic_surprise.note: Math.max(page, FIRST_PAGE) raises only values below 1 and leaves page >= 1 unchanged. It runs before page - 1 is derived, so the Integer.MIN_VALUE overflow is avoided. Both former uses of page (the query and the pagination model) now read currentPage, so the fetched page and the rendered page cannot disagree. Pages past the end and non-numeric input behave as before.

test_adequacy.note: One MockMvc parameterized test covers 0, -1 and Integer.MIN_VALUE. It asserts the list view, currentPage 1 on the model, and a captured Pageable with page index 0. Without the clamp, PageRequest.of(-1, 5) throws and the test fails. If only the query or only the model were clamped, one of the two assertions would fail. build_passed is true.

reviewer_hedging.note: All three dispatched reviewers approved in the first round with no findings, and security-reviewer was scoped out by the plan. The recommendations are cosmetic only: comment line-wrapping, a captured-field assertion, and a helper-reuse nit. The cited file:line references I spot-checked all resolve (OwnerControllerTests.java:100 and :221-223, VetController.java:45, architecture-principles.md:85, prd.md:55/70/183).

scope_deviation.note: No build retries, consultations or design revisions. The change touches only the owner-list page parameter named by the REQ-OWN-005 bullet. The vet directory's identical paging is deliberately left alone and recorded as a PRD open question rather than changed.

rationale: A contained, well-tested clamp. The only behavior change is that page values below 1 now resolve to page 1, applied before the zero-based index is derived and used consistently for both the query and the model. Reviewers approved cleanly. A glance at the OwnerController hunk confirms it.
